title: Counting Property Tax in a Summit Reserve's Refund Need: Half-Year and Year Blocks
content:
For a returned property tax refund on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the tax part of the reserve's need is counted in blocks where the reserve pays tax installments one by one. The tax year's bills here are the property tax bills on file for the reserve received no later than the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months before it; a tax year has 2 installments.

## Rule

- **Half-year blocks.** Where the plan pays tax installments separately and at least two of the tax year's bills are paid or received, the tax part is counted in half-year blocks: each started half-year of the horizon carries one installment, the annual property tax on file divided by 2. The tax part is the number of started half-years (the horizon months divided by six, any fraction counting as a whole block) times one installment.
- **Year blocks.** Where the plan pays tax installments separately and exactly one of the tax year's bills is paid or received, the tax part is counted in year blocks: each started year of the horizon carries the whole annual property tax on file. The tax part is the number of started years (the horizon months divided by twelve, any fraction counting as a whole block) times the annual property tax on file.
- Where the plan does not pay tax installments separately, or none of the tax year's bills is paid or received, this rule does not apply.

Whether the plan pays tax installments separately is shown in the plan schedule of charges paid. Withdrawn bills are not counted as paid or received.

## Block counts

| Horizon months | Started half-years | Started years |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 |
| 1 to 6 | 1 | 1 |
| 7 to 12 | 2 | 1 |
| 13 to 18 | 3 | 2 |
| 19 to 24 | 4 | 2 |

## Hypothetical illustration

Annual property tax on file 3,000.00, horizon 7 months. With two of the tax year's bills paid or received: 2 started half-years times 1,500.00, a tax part of 3,000.00. With exactly one: 1 started year times 3,000.00, also 3,000.00; at a horizon of 13 months the year blocks give 6,000.00 and the half-year blocks 4,500.00.
